component.name: Odin Sphere Leifthrasir PC
component.summary: PC port of Odin Sphere Leifthrasir (bring your own game package)

description.p: An unofficial native PC port of Vanillaware's Odin Sphere Leifthrasir (PS4). The game's own x86-64 code runs on the PC with a replacement for the PS4 system libraries and a Vulkan renderer derived from shadPS4.

No game files are included. Install your own Odin Sphere Leifthrasir PS4 package from the launcher: CUSA05083 (USA) 1.00 and 1.01, CUSA01290 (Japan) 1.00 and 1.02, CUSA05262 (Europe) 1.00 and 1.01, or CUSA03873 1.00 (Hong Kong and Asia).

ul.li: Refined and Classic mode, with a Portuguese (Brazil) translation of the text and the in-game art
Optional cheats, changed in game with the F10 menu
Controller rebinding, Xbox and PlayStation button prompts, Skip Intro and Exit Game
Render resolution, aspect ratio, SMAA, FSR 1, texture filtering and frame rate options
Trophies, a Bug Report page and a built-in updater

description.p: An unofficial fan-made port. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Vanillaware, Atlus, SEGA, Sony Interactive Entertainment or any other rights holder, and it contains none of their files.
